name: Differential capacitor
summary: This representation distinguishes a differential capacitive arrangement with related variable capacitances.
description: This representation distinguishes a differential capacitive arrangement with related variable capacitances. Related capacitor sections change in a coordinated differential arrangement. The common and section terminals therefore matter to interpreting the complete circuit.
Show those electrodes and the adjustment relationship in the detailed schematic. A single capacitance value or a two-terminal capacitor representation can hide the additional circuit interface.
readingNotes: Identify the electrode/common connections and the intended adjustment relationship.
A differential capacitor is not a generic two-terminal fixed capacitor.
